Establish and enhance operational processes, controls, governance mechanisms, and reporting frameworks across cybersecurity functions. Support continuous improvement initiatives by leveraging data, automation, and industry best practices. Application Security & Tool Adoption Support the adoption and optimization of application security tools and secure coding practices. Partner with stakeholders to drive remediation activities resulting from code scanning, container security, and application security assessments. review_candidates.title: Systems Verification Engineer I
review_candidates.description: Job Description BAE Systems is seeking a systems engineer with experience in requirements identification and IBM Rational DOORS for an exciting opportunity to support the Air Force's acquisition of the next generation Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM), the LGM-35A Sentinel system of systems. This systems engineer will assist the United States Air Force (USAF) in managing its internal program requirements for Sentinel program, analyzing the Prime contractor’s DOORS data modules, analyzing the Prime contractor's CAMEO/SysML models, and preparing reports for System Qualification. The candidate will interface with the Prime Contractor to ensure it meets the U.S. Government’s intent with respect to requirements products and artifacts. The candidate will also consult regularly with the USAF's system program office (SPO) concerning external stakeholder needs and various requirements-related topics. This unique position will allow the candidate to view all requirements efforts for the Sentinel weapon system and will provide great growth potential. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing team in a large defense company with an extraordinary positive culture and mission focus. In this position, you will provide direct support to a national security-critical weapon system throughout engineering development, deployment, and sustainment. You will help support several hundred personnel providing the government with ICBM expertise. You will become a trusted mission partner to the innovative, digital engineering-driven Air Force organization that is responsible to design, build, test, transition, and sustain the world’s safest, most secure, and effective land-based nuclear deterrent, on-schedule. BAE Systems has earned accolades as a “Top Workplace” in Utah based on employee feedback for eight consecutive years, earning special distinction for providing a healthy work-life balance for our valued employees. BAE Systems is the only DoD contractor in Utah to have earned this distinction. #ASFS Required Education, Experience, & Skills B.S. in an Engineering or STEM field. Proactive person with a positive attitude and “team player” mentality. Highly organized with acute attention to detail and willingness to take ownership. Possess a willingness to learn while also sharing your current knowledge/skills. Proactively provides ideas/thought. Strong communication skills. Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills Direct experience with the Sentinel or MMIII weapon systems. Experience with Dassault’s Cameo or other MBSE tools (Rhapsody, etc.) Possesses an Active DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance. Master's Degree in an engineering or STEM field. Experience with DOORS. Pay Information Full-Time Salary Range: $59023 - $100339 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. About BAE Systems Intelligence & Security BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Intelligence & Security (I&S), based in McLean, Virginia, designs and delivers advanced defense, intelligence, and security solutions that support the important missions of our customers. Our pride and dedication shows in everything we do—from intelligence analysis, cyber operations and IT expertise to systems development, systems integration, and operations and maintenance services. Knowing that our work enables the U.S. military and government to recognize, manage and defeat threats inspires us to push ourselves and our technologies to new levels. review_candidates.description: Position Description & Qualifications Looking for an opportunity to lead complex, high-impact technical projects as a Senior Technical Project Manager? Bring your project management experience and technical expertise to support the CMS Eligibility Support Program. Serco supports implementation of the Affordable Care Act as the prime contractor for the CMS Eligibility Support contract under the Division of Offline Verifications and Operations. Serco is seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager to manage complex technical projects from initiation through completion. This position will oversee project schedules, resources, risks, dependencies, technical requirements, testing, implementation, and customer communication. The Senior Technical Project Manager may also provide leadership to other project managers and support program-level initiatives consisting of multiple related projects. In This Role, You Will Manage large, complex technical projects from initiation through completion. Manage three to four large technical projects in different lifecycle phases simultaneously. Manage program-level initiatives that include multiple related projects requiring close coordination with project managers. Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, action items, and status reports. Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions when schedule, quality, productivity, or customer objectives are at risk. Lead project briefings, technical meetings, and status reviews with customer representatives, company leadership, project teams, and external vendors. Coordinate with technical managers to secure the personnel and resources required to achieve project objectives. Analyze dependencies across assigned projects and other active program initiatives. Develop risk mitigation and contingency plans. Ensure projects follow established procedures, governance requirements, contract expectations, and delivery schedules. Support compliance with applicable Serco administrative policies, human resources practices, contract administration procedures, laws, and regulations. Prepare memoranda, reports, presentations, and other project documentation for daily and weekly meetings. Analyze user, system, and application needs and evaluate technical and functional requirements. Confirm that proposed solutions and designs align with approved project requirements. Review test plans and scenarios and support production deployments to minimize disruption to program operations. Conduct spot audits to verify that project managers are following required governance and project management processes. Support the development of statements of work, operating models, policies, standards, procedures, and performance measures for application management. Facilitate Joint Application Design sessions and maintain focus on approved objectives, scope, and achievable project timelines. Document lessons learned and develop recommendations for process improvements. Train and mentor team members on Scaled Agile Framework principles, governance processes, project leadership, and Serco objectives. Lead assigned teams, meetings, and administrative activities. Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned. To Be Successful In This Role You Will Have A bachelor’s degree in any field. A minimum of seven years of experience leading information technology projects or programs. An active Project Management Professional certification. The ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust. The ability to travel up to 10 percent, as required. Experience applying at least one of the following project delivery methodologies: Scaled Agile Framework, Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall software development lifecycle. Experience managing project or program teams that include internal and external resources. Experience presenting project or program information to executive sponsors. Experience communicating technical project information to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project. Experience using Jira, SharePoint, and ServiceNow. Preferred Qualifications Scaled Agile Framework Agilist, Scrum Master, PMI Agile Certified Practitioner, or Information Technology Infrastructure Library certification. Experience supporting the federal government or another highly regulated environment. Experience leading cloud modernization initiatives in Amazon Web Services or Microsoft Azure environments. Familiarity with Capability Maturity Model Integration, operational governance, and enterprise project management office standards. Knowledge of project management processes, practices, strategies, and methods. Experience resolving conflicts among project managers, technical teams, stakeholders, or vendors. Experience leading across multiple business and technology organizations. Ability to approach project challenges creatively and analytically. Ability to operate independently and make timely project decisions. Ability to adapt project plans to changing priorities, requirements, and timelines. Ability to build collaboration among technical and nontechnical team members. Ability to research project-related issues, technologies, and products. Ability to learn and apply new technologies. Written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills. A collaborative and service-oriented leadership approach. Sound judgment, professionalism, and personal accountability.
